effects.description: Button Press Feedback · Duration spring · 420 ms / bounce 0.25
effects.descriptionZh: 按钮按压反馈，使用时长型弹簧；420 ms / 回弹 0.25。

effects.name: Hover Color Transition
effects.description: Hover Color Transition · 220 ms · Reprise
effects.descriptionZh: 悬停配色过渡 · 220 ms · Reprise

effects.name: Selector
effects.description: A straight wheel with a crisp center, soft distant rows, inertial dragging and snap selection.
effects.descriptionZh: 直列滚轮，中心清晰，远处渐隐虚化；拖动后带惯性吸附到最近选项。

effects.name: Glass Segmented Radio Control
effects.description: Glass Segmented Radio Control · 500 ms · Uiverse.io · chase2k25
effects.descriptionZh: 玻璃分段单选 · 500 ms · Uiverse.io · chase2k25

effects.name: Dropdown Menu
effects.description: Dropdown Menu · 400 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单 · 400 ms · Ariadne

effects.description: Folder · 640 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 文件夹 · 640 ms · Ariadne

effects.name: Glass Folder
effects.description: A frosted flap tilts forward as document cards fan out and lift.
effects.descriptionZh: 磨砂翻盖向前倾斜，文件卡片错峰扇开并抬起。

effects.name: Scroll Progress
effects.description: Hover the current chapter pill to open navigation, then click a chapter to jump.
effects.descriptionZh: 圆环跟随真实阅读进度，悬停胶囊自动展开，点击章节定位。

effects.name: Hook Sidebar
effects.description: A fine hooked rail marks selection while a neutral rail follows hover or focus.
effects.descriptionZh: 细钩线标记当前项，灰色轨道跟随悬停与焦点。

effects.name: Rail TOC
effects.description: A reading rail with a paper plane that follows the current section.
effects.descriptionZh: 纸飞机沿层级轨道跟随阅读进度，经过的路径与节点逐步填实。

effects.name: Card Expansion
effects.description: Card Expansion · 540 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 卡片展开 · 540 ms · Ariadne

effects.name: Typewriter Text
effects.description: Reveal text at a fixed typing rate with a blinking block cursor.
effects.descriptionZh: 文字按固定速度逐字打出，末尾光标按时间闪烁。

effects.name: Soft Blur In
effects.description: Characters fade in, drift upward and sharpen individually.
effects.descriptionZh: 文字逐字从轻微上移与柔焦中变得清晰。

effects.name: Short Slide Down
effects.description: Words enter from above and form a growing stack that stays centered.
effects.descriptionZh: 词语从上方依次落下，整组位置随词数调整并始终居中。

effects.name: Kinetic Center Build
effects.description: Words enter from the right and push existing words into a centered phrase.
effects.descriptionZh: 词语从右侧进入，推挤已有文字，逐步组成居中的完整短句。

effects.name: Period Drop
effects.description: Letters rise into view before an inline period falls, stretches and bounces twice.
effects.descriptionZh: 字母上升入场，句点从上方落下并以拉伸、压扁和两次回弹收尾。

effects.name: Outline Trace
effects.description: Trace actual glyph contours, then reveal their fill from bottom to top.
effects.descriptionZh: 沿真实字形轮廓逐字描绘，再由下往上填充字面。

effects.name: Glyph Anatomy
effects.description: Metric guides, contour anchors and Bezier handles show how a glyph is constructed.
effects.descriptionZh: 显示度量线、轮廓锚点和贝塞尔手柄，字形从线段构建为曲线。

effects.name: Encrypted Text
effects.description: Encrypted Text · editable content and live parameters
effects.descriptionZh: 逐字解码 · 可编辑内容与实时参数

effects.name: Gooey Input
effects.description: Gooey Input · editable content and live parameters
effects.descriptionZh: 黏性搜索输入 · 可编辑内容与实时参数

effects.name: Flip Words
effects.description: Flip Words · editable content and live parameters
effects.descriptionZh: 词语翻替 · 可编辑内容与实时参数

effects.name: Liquid Image Carousel
effects.description: A fixed image card with a liquid edge reveal, local refraction and bottom arrow / capsule navigation.
effects.descriptionZh: 固定卡片中的图片从侧边展开液态覆盖，通过底部箭头或胶囊分页切换。

effects.name: Duration Input
effects.description: A compact duration input that springs apart to edit and joins on confirmation.
effects.descriptionZh: 紧凑的时长输入，点击后弹开编辑，确认后重新合拢。

effects.name: Rounded Checkboxes
effects.description: Independent native checkboxes with a soft fill and checkmark transition.
effects.descriptionZh: 可独立勾选的偏好列表，方框填色与勾号柔和过渡。

effects.name: Page Navigation
effects.description: Page Navigation · 400 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 页面导航 · 400 ms · Ariadne

effects.name: Staggered Character Reveal
effects.description: Staggered Character Reveal · 1160 ms · 个人网站
effects.descriptionZh: 文字逐字上移揭示 · 1160 ms · 个人网站

effects.name: Local Text Scramble and Recovery
effects.description: Local Text Scramble and Recovery · 200 ms · 个人网站
effects.descriptionZh: 局部字符扰动与恢复 · 200 ms · 个人网站

effects.name: Glyph Decode Wall
effects.description: Glyph Decode Wall · 2600 ms · 原创实现
effects.descriptionZh: 文字解码墙 · 2600 ms · 原创实现

effects.name: Hover Preview
effects.description: Inline words reveal a floating image that follows the pointer.
effects.descriptionZh: 文字悬停时浮出图片，随指针轻微偏移和倾斜。

effects.name: Album Rail
effects.description: A fan of album sleeves, with records that slide out and spin.
effects.descriptionZh: 唱片封套沿扇形展开，悬停探出黑胶，点击后抽出旋转。

effects.name: Orbit Reel
effects.description: A rotating ring of cards opens into a navigable arc.
effects.descriptionZh: 旋转的卡片圆环，点击后展开为可切换的弧形。

effects.name: Elastic Reel
effects.description: Elastic image slices with pointer magnification and click-to-open images.
effects.descriptionZh: 窄幅图像随指针联动放大，点击弹性展开为完整画面。

effects.name: Staggered Loading Dots
effects.description: Staggered Loading Dots · 1200 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 三点交错跳动 · 1200 ms · Ariadne

effects.name: Finger Tapping
effects.description: Finger Tapping · 1200 ms · Uiverse.io · Pradeepsaranbishnoi
effects.descriptionZh: 手指敲击 · 1200 ms · Uiverse.io · Pradeepsaranbishnoi

effects.name: Typewriter
effects.description: Typewriter · 3000 ms · Uiverse.io · Nawsome
effects.descriptionZh: 打字机 · 3000 ms · Uiverse.io · Nawsome

effects.name: Yin Yang Loader
effects.description: Yin Yang Loader · 3000 ms · Uiverse.io · fthisilak
effects.descriptionZh: 太极加载 · 3000 ms · Uiverse.io · fthisilak

effects.name: Pulse Scale and Ripple
effects.description: Pulse Scale and Ripple · 1300 ms · Ariadne
effects.descriptionZh: 脉冲缩放与扩散 · 1300 ms · Ariadne

effects.name: Watercolor Original
effects.description: Six noise layers and paper grain create the layered wash of the original watercolor.
effects.descriptionZh: 六层噪声与纸面细颗粒叠成流动水彩，保留首版的多层晕染。

effects.name: Watercolor Flow
effects.description: Six gradient-noise layers create fine watercolor bands that blend through a double warp field.
effects.descriptionZh: 六层渐变噪声带来更细密的水彩纹理，流动色带沿双重扭曲场交融。

effects.name: ASCII Sharks
effects.description: Top-down sharks and small fish drawn on a configurable character grid.
effects.descriptionZh: 俯视游动的鲨鱼与小鱼，以可调密度的字符网格构成动态背景。

effects.name: Particle Tide
effects.description: An original ocean of particles with rolling swells and click ripples.
effects.descriptionZh: 粒子构成连续起伏的海面，可移动指针涌浪、点击叠加涟漪。

effects.name: Chromatic Button
effects.description: A tactile chromatic button with projected reflections, whole-material colour flow and native interactions.
effects.descriptionZh: 带球面反射、整体换色与真实按钮交互的流彩材质。

effects.name: Liquid Glass Logo
effects.description: A droplet forms a refractive glass tile, then its glass and rings dissolve into the resting logo on the shared #f1f1f1 gray surface.
effects.descriptionZh: 液滴聚合成折射玻璃图标，玻璃与波纹消退后保留正常大小的 Logo；默认使用统一的 #f1f1f1 灰色画布。

effects.name: Next.js Gooey Menu
effects.description: A gray circular mark and three-row status tooltip expand through a gooey SVG filter.
effects.descriptionZh: 灰色圆形标志与三行状态气泡通过 SVG 黏连滤镜展开和收合。

effects.name: Vertical Tooltip Menu
effects.description: Three vertically stacked icons share a clipped tooltip that follows hover and keyboard focus.
effects.descriptionZh: 三枚竖向图标共享一个裁切提示层，提示随悬停和键盘聚焦滑动。

effects.name: Vercel Command Search
effects.description: A compact search trigger morphs into a grouped command panel with filtering, arrow-key selection and Escape.
effects.descriptionZh: 紧凑搜索入口变形成分组命令面板，可搜索、方向键选择、Esc 收起。

effects.name: Elastic Video Player
effects.description: A portrait video with an elastic scrubber, hover time marker and animated playback feedback.
effects.descriptionZh: 竖屏视频配合可拉伸进度条、悬停时间标记与播放反馈。

effects.name: AI Multi Mode Input
effects.description: A multiline composer with attachments, Search, DeepMind and model selection. Submission stays in the local demo.
effects.descriptionZh: 带附件、搜索、DeepMind 和模型选择的多行输入；提交内容只保存在当前演示。

effects.name: Integration Mention Input
effects.description: Recognizes @yt, @google and @notion, expands integration cards and sends them with local messages.
effects.descriptionZh: 识别 @yt、@google、@notion，展开集成卡片并随消息发送；保持本地演示。

effects.name: Vercel Tooltip
effects.description: A gray icon toolbar with a shared moving tooltip and keyboard hints.
effects.descriptionZh: 灰色胶囊图标栏，共享气泡跟随悬停项目并显示快捷键。

effects.name: Devouring Details Sign In
effects.description: An underlined input whose text disintegrates into particles when submitted.
effects.descriptionZh: 极简下划线输入框，提交时文字从右向左化为粒子消散。

effects.name: Oliver Parallax
effects.description: Pan an endless image canvas in any direction, or switch to the original multi-column scroll parallax.
effects.descriptionZh: 图片在可四向拖拽的无限画布中循环排列，也可切回原版多列滚动视差。

effects.name: Rotating Scroll Stack
effects.description: The next image rises while the current card shrinks and rotates; scrolling reverses the stack.
effects.descriptionZh: 后张图片从底部进入，前张同步缩小并倾斜，滚动可反向回看。

effects.name: Scaling Scroll Stack
effects.description: Cards pin one by one; earlier layers shrink and retain a stepped edge.
effects.descriptionZh: 卡片逐张停驻并露出堆叠边缘，前层随整体滚动逐渐缩小。

effects.name: Perspective Text Scroll
effects.description: Text advances on a tilted 3D plane, with perspective widening the nearer lines.
effects.descriptionZh: 文字沿固定三维倾角向上推进，透视投影让近处字形向两侧展开。

effects.name: Expanding Icon Menu
effects.description: An icon dock that reveals each label with a sliding highlight on hover or focus.
effects.descriptionZh: 悬停或聚焦图标时，菜单项横向展开，文字与浅色底同步滑入。

effects.name: Depth Ribbon
effects.description: A ribbon of images winding through three-dimensional space, with overview and ride cameras.
effects.descriptionZh: 图片沿三维曲线串成图带，镜头在全貌与穿行之间切换。

effects.name: Passage Gallery
effects.description: A tiled image tunnel with continuous travel, pointer look and photos that open out of the walls.
effects.descriptionZh: 沿铺满图片的隧道穿行，视角跟随指针，图片从墙面展开。

effects.name: Glass Generate Button
effects.description: A translucent pill with a moving rim, reflective sweep and a tilted press.
effects.descriptionZh: 透明胶囊按钮，带移动描边、反光扫动与按压倾转。

effects.name: Waving Tilt Card
effects.description: A gradient profile card with fifteen tilt zones and a waving hand.
effects.descriptionZh: 三色渐变个人卡片，随 15 个感应区域倾斜并挥手。

effects.name: Rig Assembly
effects.description: Two arms bring image panels into place, assembling the picture from top to bottom.
effects.descriptionZh: 两侧机械臂搬运图片分块，从上到下拼接成完整画面。

effects.name: Card Swap
effects.description: The front card takes the back slot while the others step forward.
effects.descriptionZh: 前卡直接退到后层，其余卡片沿固定斜向槽位前移。

effects.name: Wake Slider
effects.description: A bar slider leaves a rising wake behind a fast drag.
effects.descriptionZh: 无滑块的细条数值轨道，快速滑过的条留下弹起尾波。

effects.name: Elastic Image Compare
effects.description: A flexible divider and its matching image mask follow the same curve.
effects.descriptionZh: 分割线随拖动弯曲，图片裁切使用同一条曲线。

effects.name: Floating Label Input
effects.description: The label lifts into a measured notch in the outline on focus.
effects.descriptionZh: 聚焦时标签逐字抬升，描边从标签中间向两边让出缺口。

effects.name: Floating Ring Carousel
effects.description: Cards float on a continuous ring, with independent drag, settle and inward tilt.
effects.descriptionZh: 图片沿连续转盘前后交错，拖动、惯性归位与下压倾斜各自独立。

effects.name: Upload Dropzone
effects.description: Files tuck into a progress pill; oversized files bounce back.
effects.descriptionZh: 文件被吸入上传框，进度胶囊完成后回到待机；过大文件会弹回。

effects.name: Slide to Confirm
effects.description: Reach the end to unfurl the confirmation pill; partial drags spring back.
effects.descriptionZh: 滑块到达终点后向左舒展成确认胶囊，未完成时弹回。

effects.name: Aspect Ratio
effects.description: One image morphs between three crops with equal-area endpoints.
effects.descriptionZh: 同一张图片在三种等面积比例之间以弹簧形变切换。

effects.name: Create Menu
effects.description: A pill presses inward, then opens into a centered creation menu.
effects.descriptionZh: 创建按钮先轻压，再从中心展开成菜单，选择后收回。

effects.name: Eye Tracker
effects.description: Eyes follow your pointer inside a soft shape; click to make it speak.
effects.descriptionZh: 柔软立体形状里的双眼追随指针，点击后逐字说话。

effects.name: Context Meter
effects.description: Category usage forms a bar or dot field, with reversible compaction.
effects.descriptionZh: 类别用量组成条形或点阵；压缩与撤销带来数字和图形联动。

effects.name: Page Turn Cards
effects.description: Independent rigid cards turn on opposing side pivots, with a narrow projected gap and soft light.
effects.descriptionZh: 两张独立刚性卡片沿各自边轴翻转，以连续窄缝和柔光完成交接。
